panels.title: Flow waterfall - one row per stage, expand for steps
panels.description: Flat trace shape by design: every stage (build/test/deploy/release) parents directly to the flow root, not to the previous stage, because stages don't overlap in time - nesting them would misrepresent duration. See docs/tracing.md. Governance stub gates (see catalog/stepactions/governance-stub.yaml) show up here as their own child spans named "governance:<gate>" under the current stage - never mistake one for a real enforcement result; see the table below.

panels.title: Governance gates in this run - stub vs real
panels.description: Any row with governance.stub=true is not a real check result - see docs/governance-stubs.md. This is the platform's structural, loud fix for the old system's silently-always-passing exit-0 gates. Governance gates are their own spans named "governance:<gate>" (not span events - an earlier version tried to query governance.stub as an event, which TraceQL's `name =` filter can't match, and which never reached Tempo in the first place under the old background-span mechanism - see docs/tracing.md). The `name =~` regex (not `=`) is deliberate: exact-match `name =` combined with `trace:id =` was verified live to intermittently return zero rows even for spans confirmed to exist in the trace, while the regex form did not - a Tempo 2.9 TraceQL quirk, not a query bug.
